description: This Java abstract test class defines a generic testing framework for policy event strategies within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes setup routines, test methods for handling policy events, and abstract methods to be implemented by subclasses for specific event types and strategies.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyEventStrategyTest
classes.description: An abstract generic test class for event strategies related to policies, providing setup, common test methods, and abstract methods for subclasses to specify specific event types and strategies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment with a sample policy, current timestamp, and strategy instance.

methods.name: testHandleReturnsNullForNullEntity
methods.description: Tests that the handle method returns null when the entity is null.

methods.name: testHandlePolicyEvent
methods.description: Tests the handling of a policy event, verifying the policy is modified correctly with the expected timestamp and revision.

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add further assertions on the modified policy.

methods.name: getInstant
methods.description: Accessor for the timestamp used in tests.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the specific event strategy being tested.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to create a policy event instance for testing.
